concept_name: NuData US — Nuclear Engineering Academic & Workforce Intelligence Grid

typography.pairing_notes: Outfit for strong, clean, technical headings; IBM Plex Sans for dense, high-legibility tabular & scientific text; IBM Plex Mono for SOC codes, rankings, budgets, and coordinates.

entry_surfaces./: tactical command hero with real-time stats ticker left, interactive US nuclear programs & jobs map center-stage with side-by-side drawer and compare workbench

layout_and_grids.map_mode: Leaflet with CartoDB Dark Matter / Positron tiles for high-contrast tactical data markers
layout_and_grids.structure: Header (fixed glass with live BLS badge + mode switcher: All Programs | Workforce & Jobs | Compare Bench | State Heatmap) -> Hero summary banner with Cherenkov pulse -> Main 2-column or full split workspace (Interactive Leaflet Map with customized SVG pulsed markers on left/center + dynamic details drawer / compare tray) -> Secondary Analytics Grid (Growth trends, Graduates by year, Budget estimations, BLS supply vs demand gap).
layout_and_grids.compare_drawer: Sticky bottom dock for comparing up to 3 institutions side-by-side with diff highlight on enrollment, research reactor status, ABET, placement rate, and 1/5/10yr growth.

image_urls.description: High energy nuclear test reactor chamber glowing with Cherenkov radiation aesthetic
Glowing blue core plasma effect for high-tier research reactor badge
University nuclear physics and materials engineering workstation lab
Cleanroom radiation safety and nuclear technician facility personnel

micro_interactions.marker_pulse: Continuous subtle 2s ease-in-out ripple on active research reactor sites (Cherenkov blue ring)
micro_interactions.drawer_slide: Spring physics transition (stiffness 300, damping 30) for program inspection drawer
micro_interactions.compare_bar: Slide up from bottom with stagger children for program metric cards
micro_interactions.counter_transition: Animated number tick on state hover / filter change

accessibility.data_testids: All buttons, filters, map markers, table rows, tab triggers, modal toggles, and compare slots must include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='program-marker-mit', data-testid='tab-programs-map', data-testid='compare-btn-purdue', data-testid='filter-has-reactor').
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Map markers accessible via list keyboard navigation; Escape closes details drawer; tab indexing through program cards.
accessibility.reduced_motion: All motion.div respect prefers-reduced-motion media query

visual_enhancers.tactical_scanlines: Subtle dark gradient raster on card headers to impart command-center rigor

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. STACK: React 19 + Vite (farm-ts template) + Tailwind v4 + Lucide icons + Recharts (preinstalled) + Leaflet (run 'cd /app/frontend && yarn add leaflet react-leaflet @types/leaflet' if needed).

2. FONT SETUP: Import '@fontsource-variable/outfit' and '@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans' and '@fontsource/ibm-plex-mono' in frontend/src/index.css, setting --font-heading to Outfit and --font-sans to IBM Plex Sans.

3. DATA COVERAGE: Comprehensive curated dataset of 32+ prominent US Nuclear Engineering Programs (MIT, Michigan, Purdue, NC State, UIUC, Texas A&M, Wisconsin-Madison, Penn State, Georgia Tech, UC Berkeley, Florida, Tennessee Knoxville, Oregon State, RPI, Missouri S&T, Virginia Tech, Ohio State, Idaho State, New Mexico, Maryland, Clemson, etc.).

4. PROGRAM FIELDS REQUIRED: University name, Department, City, State, Lat/Lng coordinates, Total Enrollment (Undergrad/Grad/PhD), 1-Year Growth %, 5-Year Growth %, 10-Year Growth %, Historical Graduates by Year (2018-2025/2026), Estimated Yearly Budget ($M), Job Placement Rate %, On-Campus Research Reactor (Yes/No + Reactor power/type like PULSTAR, Breazeale, MITR-II, TRIGA), Degrees Offered (BS, MS, PhD), ABET Accreditation status, US News / National Ranking, Primary Research Focus (Fusion, SMRs, Waste Management, Thermal Hydraulics, Nuclear Forensics), Data Source citations (NEUP 2025 Sourcebook, IPEDS, ABET, Department records).

5. JOBS & WORKFORCE MAP & INTELLIGENCE: Map layer for SOC 17-2161 (Nuclear Engineers) and SOC 19-4051 (Nuclear Technicians) by state with employment counts, median annual wage ($133,970 for Engineers, $110,240 for Techs), 10-year projected openings (~800/yr for engineers, ~900/yr for techs), replacement gap analysis vs annual graduate output, and active commercial/test reactors by state.

6. LIVE BLS REFRESH / DATA LABELS: Include simulated/live BLS API data refresh trigger with timestamp, confidence metric, and clear tags for 'Verified Federal (BLS/IPEDS)', 'NEUP Academic Census', and 'Institution Estimate'.

7. INTERACTIVE FEATURES: Interactive Leaflet Map with filter pills (Degree levels, Has Research Reactor, ABET, Minimum Budget, Region), Search-as-you-type, Program Comparison tray (up to 3 universities side-by-side with delta badges), Sortable tabular view, and Rich Recharts graphs (Graduation trends, Supply vs Demand gap, Budget distribution).
8. THEME: Sleek dark tactical theme by default (#0B0F17) with Cherenkov cyan (#00F0FF) and Atomic Amber (#F59E0B) accents, with a clean light mode toggle.
